text:
maria: Quick heads-up — onboarding a new ML tenant in ap-southeast1 (Singapore). They need GPU capacity + private connectivity. Opening request so we can start quota + network prep. PTAL @cloudops

ray: Thanks — can you paste the project/billing IDs and the exact quotas you want? Also any subnet/CIDR needs?

maria: Project: redwood-tenant-42-prod
Billing: BA-87-REDFLAG
Quotas requested (initial):
```
- GPUs: accelerator.googleapis.com/tesla-a100-80gb -> current 0 -> request 6
- CPUs: compute.googleapis.com/cpus -> current 200 -> request 600 (for batch nodes)
- Static external IPs: compute.googleapis.com/addresses -> current 30 -> request 80
- Cloud NAT routers per region: compute.googleapis.com/nat_routers_per_region -> current 1 -> request 3
```
Also network pieces:
- VPC: redwood-tenant-42-vpc (new)
- Need two workload subnets in ap-southeast1: gpu-subnet (/26) and app-subnet (/24 split into /25 + /26 later)
- A small mgmt subnet (/28) for bastion and monitoring exporters
- Want Private Service Connect endpoints for Container Registry and Artifact Registry to avoid egress to public internet

jen: For the GPU nodes we should pin to specific zones (asia-southeast1-a/b). If we request 6 A100s, do you want them in a single zone or spread? Also confirm if Dedicated host / placement policy needed.

maria: Spread across a/b for AZ resilience. No dedicated host needed initially. We'll run autoscaler that may launch up to 8 n1-highcpu or custom machines attached to accelerators.

tyler: Quick cost note — if you rely on Cloud NAT with 80 static IPs, egress through NAT might get pricey. PSC (Private Service Connect) for GCR/Artifact will cut external egress charges. If they push model downloads, consider a regional cache bucket with VPC-SC or signer.

ray: Filing the quota request now. Please confirm the exact quota names I should include in the cloud support form. If you don't know the exact quota key, I'll include the human-readable names you provided.

maria: Use the accelerator and addresses quotas I listed. For CPUs use "compute.googleapis.com/cpus". For Cloud NAT routers, include "NAT routers per region".

ops-bot: Created support ticket GCP-12345678 for quota increases (queued). Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/GCP-12345678

security: Couple quick asks from Sec/Compliance —
1) Will tenant data ever traverse public internet? (we want Private Service Connect + VPC-SC if so)
2) KMS keys for model artifacts? Do you need a customer-managed key?

maria: 1) No, we plan to keep artifacts in Artifact Registry with PSC. 2) Yes, they need CMEK for artifacts and logs; I'll add the request to the form.

jen: Network routing detail — we should reserve a /22 for the tenant VPC so we have headroom: propose 10.48.0.0/22, then carve: gpu-subnet 10.48.0.0/26, app-subnet 10.48.1.0/24, mgmt 10.48.3.0/28. That avoids future overlap.

maria: Sounds good. Add the route for private google access and enable flow logs on the GPU subnet (for billing+debugging).

tyler: One more: if they plan snapshot exports to S3/GCS, account for inter-region egress. Recommend limiting large outbound transfers from the region and using regional buckets.

ray: OK — I'm adding all of that to the support case (subnets, CMEK, PSC intent, static IP increase, GPU quota). ETA on quota response typically 1-3 business days but can be longer for accelerator increases.

maria: Thx. If quota comes back rejected, fallback plan: request access to Dedicated pool in eu-west1 while we iterate.

ops-bot: Update: GCP-12345678 status -> "Awaiting internal review" (Apr 12 09:14 UTC)

ray: I'll post here when I get confirmation or if they ask for more justification (we should be ready to show projected RPS, expected token throughput, and cost estimates).

maria: I'll prepare a short justification doc with workload profile and expected token/sec + model sizes. Will ping when done. :thumbsup:

security: Also ensure audit logs retention is set to 90d for this tenant.

maria: Added to the ticket — thanks all.
